title: Virtual K-theoretic invariants of the nested Hilbert scheme on $\mathbb{C}^2$
summary: We construct a nested version of the non-commutative Hilbert scheme and embed the nested Hilbert scheme of points on $\mathbb{C}^n$ as the commutativity locus. In the $\mathbb{C}^2$-case, we exhibit this locus as the zero locus of two different sections of bundles and use this description to equip the nested Hilbert scheme of points with a perfect obstruction theory equivalent to that of Gholampour, Sheshmani and Yau.
